headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (8)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Qatar Grand Prix from pole position, 4.8s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Guanyu Zhou made the biggest climb, from P19 to P9.
Pierre Gasly had a day to forget, dropping from P7 to P12.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.

The stewards penalised HUL (10 second time penalty), PER (5 second time penalty), PER (5 second time penalty), STR (5 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty), ALB (5 second time penalty), ALB (5 second time penalty), STR (5 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty) and PER (5 second time penalty).
There were 54 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 209 points over Sergio Perez.
